scenario.title: From raw orders to trusted revenue
scenario.business_question: How much gross revenue did completed orders generate?
scenario.business_definition: Gross completed-order revenue before returns, in USD. Use the latest source order version, include only completed orders, and count each order amount once. This is neither net revenue after refunds nor the sum of payment attempts.

transformations.why: Keep one current record per order before applying business rules. Cancelled orders remain in source-conformed staging.
windows: ROW_NUMBER by orderId; newest updatedAt, then highest sourceVersion

transformations.why: Business logic belongs after staging: include completed orders exactly once.

Gross completed-order revenue before returns, in USD. Use the latest source order version, include only completed orders, and count each order amount once. This is neither net revenue after refunds nor the sum of payment attempts.

reference_sql.staging:
WITH normalized AS (
    SELECT
        orderId AS order_id,
        customerId AS customer_id,
        lower(trim(status)) AS status,
        CAST(CAST(totalPriceCents AS DECIMAL(18,2)) / 100 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS order_amount,
        upper(trim(currency)) AS currency,
        CAST(createdAt AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS ordered_at,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY orderId
            ORDER BY CAST(updatedAt AS TIMESTAMPTZ) DESC, sourceVersion DESC
        ) AS version_rank
    FROM raw_orders
)
SELECT order_id, customer_id, status, order_amount, currency, ordered_at
FROM normalized
WHERE version_rank = 1
reference_sql.safe:
SELECT order_id, customer_id, status, order_amount, currency, ordered_at
FROM stg_orders
WHERE status = 'completed'
reference_sql.fanout:
SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.status, o.order_amount, o.currency, o.ordered_at
FROM stg_orders AS o
LEFT JOIN order_items AS i ON o.order_id = i.order_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
